title: Finance controls example — transaction review (non-medical)
description: A second non-medical module on the same lgd-skeleton/1.0 contract. It runs a small deterministic rule set over a transaction ledger and reports control findings: missing approval, dual-approval breaches above a threshold, probable duplicate payments, round amounts, and weekend postings. Included to show that the same contract carries an unrelated domain without any change to the core.
idea: Transaction ledger → internal-control findings on a deterministic rule set
extension_note: Add a rule by writing a check function and registering it in RULES; thresholds live in THRESHOLDS.
